title: PWM duty for a target voltage
story: A 5 V microcontroller has no DAC, but it can make 1 kHz PWM. A 10 kohm resistor and a 1 uF capacitor smooth it. An analog circuit downstream needs about 1.25 V. Pick the PWM source with the right duty cycle so the smoothed voltage sits between 1.1 V and 1.4 V once it has settled.

goals.label: filtered voltage between 1.1 V and 1.4 V at t = 60 ms

hints: After the filter settles, the output is the average of the pulse: duty x 5 V.
The time constant is 10 kohm x 1 uF = 10 ms, so after 60 ms (6 time constants) the start-up is over.
Ripple is about 5 x D x (1 - D) x 1 ms / 10 ms: under 0.1 V for any of these duties.
